title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting. $\hat\pi_{0,3}$ is the profinite fundamental group of $\mathbb P^1\setminus\{0,1,\infty\}$, a free profinite group on two generators. It has trivial centre. $\mathfrak S_3$ embeds in $\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi_{0,3})$ as the outer action permuting the three punctures. $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$ is the corresponding extension $1\to\hat\pi_{0,3}\to\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}\to\mathfrak S_3\to1$. Concretely it is $PSL_2(\mathbb Z)^\wedge$, since $\Gamma(2)/\{\pm1\}$ is free of rank 2 with quotient $\mathfrak S_3$; the previous page writes $SL_2$. Because the centre is trivial, this extension is the pull-back of $\mathrm{Aut}(\hat\pi)\to\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi)$ along $\mathfrak S_3\to\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi)$.

Problem being served. The previous page showed two things:
- An automorphism of $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+$ that is the identity on $\hat\pi$ and on $\mathfrak S_3$ is trivial (via $f(\sigma_\infty)=\sigma_\infty g$ with $g$ central, hence $g=1$).
- A necessary condition for an automorphism of $\hat\pi$ to extend: its outer class must commute with $\mathfrak S_3$.

This page proves the condition is also sufficient, by a pull-back argument.
1. Let $\Gamma\subset\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi_{0,3})$ be the centraliser of $\mathfrak S_3$.
2. $\Gamma\cap\mathfrak S_3$ lies in the centre of $\mathfrak S_3$, which is trivial. Hence $\mathfrak S_3\times\Gamma\hookrightarrow\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi)$.
3. Pulling back $\mathrm{Aut}\to\mathrm{Out}$ (valid because $Z(\hat\pi)=1$) gives an extension (33): $1\to\hat\pi\to E\to\mathfrak S_3\times\Gamma\to1$.
4. The preimage of $\mathfrak S_3$ in $E$ is $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$, normal with quotient $\Gamma$. This is extension (34): $1\to\hat{\mathfrak S}^+\to E\to\Gamma\to1$.
5. (34) defines an outer action of $\Gamma$ on $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$.

Proposition. $\mathrm{Out}(\hat\pi_{0,3})^{\mathfrak S_3}$ is isomorphic to the group of outer automorphisms of $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$ that induce the trivial outer automorphism on $\mathfrak S_3$.

Marginal notes.
- "vrai et irrelevant" beside the $\Gamma\cap\mathfrak S_3$ step.
- "Mais tout automorphisme de $\mathfrak S_3$ est intérieur": since $\mathrm{Out}(\mathfrak S_3)=1$, the condition in the Proposition is automatic once $\hat\pi$ is preserved.

Next page. It lifts the result to genuine automorphisms (diagram 35) and shows the extension $E^!$ of $\Gamma$ by $\hat\pi$ splits, by normalising $u(\sigma_\infty)=\sigma_\infty$.

Purpose. This is the group-theoretic preparation for treating $G_{\mathbb Q}$ / $\widehat{GT}$-type groups as outer automorphisms of the 'Teichmüller group' $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$ (Longue Marche program).
errors: The previous page writes $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}\simeq SL(2,\mathbb Z)^\wedge$; it should be $PSL(2,\mathbb Z)^\wedge$ (an extension of $\mathfrak S_3$ by $\widehat{F}_2$ with trivial centre).

The Proposition implicitly assumes outer automorphisms of $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+$ preserve $\hat\pi_{0,3}$, i.e. that the kernel is characteristic (or the condition is meant to include this). The margin remark that every automorphism of $\mathfrak S_3$ is inner shows the stated condition alone is vacuous.

The bijectivity of $\Gamma\to\mathrm{Out}(\hat{\mathfrak S}^+\mid\ldots)$ also uses $Z(\hat{\mathfrak S}^+)=1$ and the injectivity from the previous page. These steps are sketched, not fully written, but they are standard and correct.

ideas.what: Outer automorphisms of the free profinite group of rank 2 commuting with the $\mathfrak S_3$ symmetry correspond to outer automorphisms of $\widehat{PSL_2(\mathbb Z)}$ (an extension of $\mathfrak S_3$ by $\widehat F_2$) that preserve the quotient structure
ideas.modern_name: Pull-back of Aut→Out along an outer action (centre-free extension theory); $\mathfrak S_3$-centraliser in $\mathrm{Out}(\widehat F_2)$, ambient group of $\widehat{GT}$
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard group theory (Eilenberg–MacLane type extension theory). The GT context is due to Drinfeld (1990), Ihara, Lochak–Schneps, Nakamura; the anabelian setting is treated by Hoshi–Minamide–Mochizuki and Minamide–Nakamura.
ideas.where_published: Theme of the Esquisse d'un programme (Teichmüller tower, $\widehat{SL_2(\mathbb Z)}$, $G_{\mathbb Q}$ action); this explicit lemma is not known to be published.

ideas.what: Splitting of the extension of $\Gamma$ by $\hat\pi_{0,3}$ by normalising automorphisms to fix the order-2 element $\sigma_\infty$ (continued on the next page)
ideas.modern_name: Normalisation of $\widehat{GT}$ elements (e.g. $x\mapsto x^\lambda$, $y\mapsto f^{-1}y^\lambda f$) / conjugacy of finite-order elements in $\widehat{PSL_2(\mathbb Z)}$

deep.surprise_reason: A clean but routine group-theoretic lemma, foreshadowing how $\widehat{GT}$ is later realised as automorphisms of $\widehat{PSL_2(\mathbb Z)}$ / profinite braid groups. Interesting historically as Grothendieck's own route, but nothing here is absent from later literature in substance.
transcription_corrections: Top annotation reads '332' with '⊂ Aut ext($\hat\pi_{0,3}$)' added above the first line.

First line likely 'C'est suffisant, en effet soit Γ le groupe des automorphismes ext. de $\hat\pi_{0,3}$ qui ont cette propriété (lesquels ne préservent pas pour la plupart la structure : lacets de $\hat\pi_{0,3}$)'. The parenthesis is uncertain, but 'le principe[?] pas[?] pour la manière[?]' is not right.
'car $\mathfrak S$ le centre de $\mathfrak S_3$ est trivial': the stray $\mathfrak S$ is a struck symbol; the intended text is 'car le centre de $\mathfrak S_3$ est trivial'.
Proposition line should read 'qui commutent à $\mathfrak S_3$ est isom. au groupe des automorphismes ext. de $\hat{\mathfrak S}^+_{0,3}$…' ('au groupe', not 'comme groupe').
Left margin bottom: 'Mais tout automorphisme de $\mathfrak S_3$ est intérieur' is confirmed. Left margin middle: 'vrai et irrelevant' is plausible.
